title: My carts
lead: Up to eight storefronts, each with a cart of up to ten lines. Each order is prepared with one seller; prices, fees and availability are checked again before preparation.
added: Item added to the cart draft.
clearResolved: Remove cart draft without cancelling preparation
drafts_full: You already have eight carts. Finish or remove a storefront’s cart before adding another.
draftConflict: This cart changed since your last action. Your carts are saved; make your choice again using the version shown.
quantityError: Enter a whole number from 1 to 999.
quoteClosed: This offer requires a quote or a confirmed exact price. No amount is chosen on your behalf.
notExact: A line in this cart has no exact price. Remove it or review the prices before preparing the cart.
different_seller: This cart already contains another seller. Finish or clear its draft before changing storefront.
submitted: A preparation has already been requested. Look up its result before editing the cart.
full: The cart already contains ten lines.
invalid: This addition would exceed permitted quantities or contains an invalid option.
draftUnavailable: The draft cannot be saved in this tab. No request has been sent.
draftNotice: Each cart is saved for 24 hours after its last change in this tab, for your account and this network. Switching storefronts keeps your other carts. Address and consent must be entered again after reload.
offline: You are offline. The draft and any address already entered remain on this screen; sending is paused.
refreshRequired: Review conditions after the network returns, then give new consent.
unavailable: Cart conditions cannot currently be confirmed.
missing: This line is no longer available. Remove it before preparing the cart.
notFound: No preparation was found. You can enter the same choices again to resume the same request after another lookup.
recoverHint: The address was not saved. Voluntarily enter it again exactly. The same key will be reused only if choices, prices, fees and address exactly match the original request digest.
mismatch: The reconstructed choices do not match the submitted request. Nothing new is sent. Look up its result or explicitly abandon this intention before reviewing conditions.
stopHint: The server must first confirm that this key is closed. An existing preparation remains accessible and is not cancelled by this choice.
stopped: This intention is closed. You can unlock the draft and review conditions before making a new request.
shareUnavailable: The public link cannot currently be shared.
shareNotice: Only the public offer is shared, never your cart, order or address.
feesLater: Final fees and total come with the fulfillment method, before you agree.

quickAdd.chooseLead: Choose a variant that is actually offered and the quantity, then add it to the basket.
